zh: 只有 7 位，每个 ? 位最多有 9 种取值，所有补全方案可以直接搜索；关键是按位从小到大枚举，输出就自然是字典序。
预先算出从第 i 位到末尾能凑出的最小工时和最大工时（? 位分别取 0 和 day_hours）；搜索时若剩余工时不在这个区间内就立即剪枝。
从后往前求 low[i]、high[i]；深搜 visit(i, remaining)：越界就返回，i=7 时记录当前串；? 位按 0..day_hours 升序尝试，固定位只走一个分支。最后先输出方案数，再逐行输出各方案；结果可能有几十万行，要用缓冲输出。
en: There are only 7 positions and at most 9 values per ?, so all completions can be searched directly. The key is to try digits in increasing order position by position, so the output is automatically in lexicographic order.

Precompute the minimum and maximum hours that positions i..6 can still contribute (a ? contributes 0 or day_hours). During the search, prune immediately when the remaining hours fall outside that range.

Compute low[i] and high[i] from the back. Depth-first visit(i, remaining): return if remaining is out of range; at i = 7 record the current string; at a ? try 0..day_hours in ascending order, and a fixed digit has a single branch. Print the number of schedules and then each schedule on its own line; there can be hundreds of thousands of lines, so buffer the output.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Enumerate digits from left to right in ascending order, prune with the minimum and maximum hours still achievable, and keep the leaves that reach the total exactly.

## Correctness

Every completion corresponds to a unique root-to-leaf path: a fixed position has a single branch and an unknown position enumerates all legal digits. Pruning only removes prefixes that cannot reach the total, so nothing is missed, and the ascending depth-first search naturally outputs in lexicographic order.

## Complexity

O(9^7) time and O(7R) output space; R is at most 273127, within the 4 MiB output limit.
